issues.problem: NEW (one of the 49 keys). Two problems in one label. (a) Grammar: 'Crecer púas' is a calque of the English command 'Grow spikes'; crecer is intransitive, so Spanish needs a causative ('hacer crecer') or a noun phrase. ru uses the transitive infinitive Отрастить шипы. (b) Pattern break inside the DNA panel: the three sibling mutation labels rendered by ui_menus.js:173-176 are noun phrases ('Caparazón de sílice', 'Más masa', 'Flagelos más rápidos') while this one is a bare infinitive.

Visible labels localize; tooltips and screen-reader announcements do not, so es (and tr/fil) inherit Russian accessibility strings.
